content: I tabab rok Adam me yan i mada’ ngak Abraham
I Adam e chitamngin Seth, me Seth e chitamngin Enosh, me Enosh e chitamngin Kenan,
me Kenan e chitamngin Mahalalel, me Mahalalel e chitamngin Jared.
I Jared e chitamngin Enok, me Enok e chitamngin Methuselah; me Methuselah e chitamngin Lamek,
ni ir e chitamngin Noah. Me Noah e dalip e pagel ni fak: i Shem, Ham, nge Jafeth.
Pi pumo’on ni pifak Jafeth — e Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek, nge Tiras — ni yad e chitamngin e pi ganong ntunguy fithingrad ngorad.
Ma pi’in owchen Gomer e girdi’ nu Ashkenaz, Rifath, Togarmah.
Ma pi’in owchen Javan e girdi’ nu Elishah, Spain, Cyprus, ngu Rhodes.
Ma pi pumo’on ni pifak Ham — e Kush, Egypt, Libya, nge Kanaan — yad e chitamngin e pi ganong ntunguy fithingrad ngorad.
Pi’in owchen Kush e girdi’ nu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, nge Sabteka. Ma pi’in owchen Raamah e girdi’ nu Sheba nge Dedan.
(Me Kush e immoy be’ ni pumo’on ni fak ni Nimrod fithingan, ni ir e cha’ nth’abi som’on e girdi’ nu fayleng nib falu’ ko mael.)
Ma pi’in owchen Egypt e girdi’ nu Lydia, Anam, Lehab, Naftuh,
Pathrus, Kasluh, nge Krete (ni aram e gin ni yib e pi girdi’ nu Filistia riy).
Pi pumo’on ni pifak Kanaan — e Sidon e ba nganni’, nge Heth — ni yow e chitamngin e pi ganong ntunguy fithingrow ngorad.
Me Kanaan e ku ir e chitamngin e girdi’ nu Jebus, Amor, Girgash,
Hiv, Ark, Sin,
Arvad, Zemar, nge Hamath.
Pi pumo’on ni pifak Shem — e Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, nge Meshek — yad e chitamngin e pi genong ntunguy fithingrad ngorad.
I Arpakshad e chitamngin Shelah, ni chitamngin Eber.
Ma l’agruw e pumo’on ni fak Eber; reb e ni tunguy fithingan ni Peleg,
ni fan e ngiyal’nem e ke yu raba’ e girdi’ u fayleng, me reb e ni tunguy Joktan ngak.
Pi’in ni owchen Joktan e girdi’ nu Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ofir, Havilah, ngu Jobab.
Irera’ fare um i girdi’ ni tabab rok Shem nge mada’ ngak Abram: i Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
nge Abram (ni kuyi manang ni Abraham).
Pi’in owchen i Ishmael
L’agruw e pumo’on ni fak Abraham, ni Isaak nge Ishmael.
Ma pi pumo’on ni pifak Ishmael e ra manged lolgen ragag nge l’agruw i ganong: i Nebayoth e bin nganni’, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Nafish, nge Kedemah.

Ma Abraham e bay reb e bpin rok ni fithingan e Keturah, ni diyennag n’el e pumo’on ni fak Abraham: i Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, nge Shual. Ma immoy l’agruw i pumo’on ni fak Jokshan: ni Sheba nge Dedan.
Me Midian e lal e pumo’on ni fak: i Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida, nge Eldaah.
Pi’in Owchen Esau
Me Isaak nib mo’on ni fak Abraham e l’agruw e pumo’on ni fak, ni Esau nge Jakob.
Ma pumo’on ni fak Esau e Elifaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, nge Korah.
Me Elifaz e mang chitamngin e tin ba’aray e ganong: ni Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, nge Amalek.
Me Reuel e mang chitamngin e pi ganong ko Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, nge Mizzah.
Pi’in nri Girdi’en yu Edom

Ri girdi’en yu Edom e pi’in owchen fapi pumo’on ni ba’aray ni pifak Seir: Lotan, ni ir e chitamngin fa gal ke girdi’ rok Hori nge Homam. (Lotan e bay be’ ni bpin ni walagen ni Timna.) Shobal, e ir e chitamngin fa yuke girdi’ ni Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefi, nge Onam. Zibeon, e l’agruw e pagel ni fak, ni Ayah nge Anah. Anah e ir e chitamngin e Dishon, ma Dishon e ir e ga’ ko fa yuke girdi’ ni Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, nge Keran. Ezer, e ir e chitamngin fa yuke girdi’ ni Bilhan, Zaavan, nge Jaakan. Dishan, e ir e chitamngin fa gal ke girdi’ ni Uz nge Aran.
Pi Pilung nu Edom
Irera’ e pi pilung ni u roged e thin ko fare nam nu Edom nra chuw bagyad me yib bagyad, u m’on ni dawor i pilung be’ nu Israel:

content.text: Bela nib mo’on ni fak Beor nu Dinhabah
Jobab nib mo’on ni fak Zerah nu Bozrah
Hadad nib mo’on ni fak Bedad nu Avith (i gel ngak yu Midian ko mael u lan fare nam nu Moab)
Baal Hanan nib mo’on ni fak Akbor
Hadad nu Pau (ni le’engin Mehetabel, ni be’ ni bpin ni fak Matred ma titaw rok e Mezahab)

content: Girdi’ nu Edom e ra weargad ko pi ganong ni ba’aray: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel, nge Iram.

footnotes.text: PELEG: Re ngachal ney e gowa lingan fare bugithin ni Hebrew ni ngan “Ki’eg.”
